labels.staleReasonFallback: Its newest snapshot could not be read.
addSources.title: Add sources
addSources.refusedFileType: Research does not read this kind of file (it reads {extensions}).
addSources.addedIndexed: Added: it is read and indexed now.
addSources.uploadHint: PDF, Word (.docx), text, Markdown and web pages (.html). A PDF made of scanned images has no text research can read.
addSources.urlAdded: Fetching {title}: Orbit Web keeps a snapshot of it, so the page changing later does not change your research.
addSources.urlHint: http or https. The Orbit server fetches it -- only from the public internet -- and keeps what it read.
addSources.existingAllUsed: Every source of this workspace is already used in this session.
addSources.existingNote: These are already stored in the workspace: nothing is uploaded again.
evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.citationsEmptyAsk: Ask a question: the passages an answer cites are listed here, each opening at its place in the source.
evidence.citationsEmptyNone: This answer cites no passage of the selected sources.
evidence.notesEmpty: No notes yet. Save an answer as a note, or write one from the sources panel.
evidence.showingEarlierCitations: Showing citations from an earlier answer.
evidence.confirmDeleteNoteBody: This removes the note permanently from this workspace.
evidence.confirmDeleteFindingBody: This removes the finding permanently from this workspace.
evidence.findingDisclaimer: A finding is a research conclusion a person reviews. Reviewed means reviewed -- it is not an approved policy, and nothing here changes Orbit's governance.
evidence.findingsEmpty: No findings yet. Add an answer as a finding to start one.
evidence.restsOnNothing: No citation: it rests on nothing yet.
newSession.noWorkspacesHint: No workspaces exist yet — create a new one above.
newSession.noClaudeBanner: Connect Claude in Settings → AI Connections to ask questions.
newSession.firstQuestionHint: Asked at once when a selected source is ready. In a new workspace it waits for you: add sources, then ask it.
newSession.firstQuestionPlaceholder: What do these sources say about…
newSession.privacy: Sources are stored on this Orbit server. When you ask, the passages retrieved from the sources you select are sent to Claude (Anthropic) to answer.
chat.emptyCopy: The sources you select are references Claude reads with each question: what it takes from them is cited, and it says what comes from elsewhere. It can use your Claude connectors too -- to make a Claude Doc, for example.
chat.placeholderReady: Ask anything -- your sources are references…
chat.placeholderPreparing: Ask anything -- your sources are still being read…
chat.placeholderEmpty: Ask anything -- or add sources as references…
chat.firstQuestionReady: Your first question is ready to ask
chat.firstQuestionKept: Your first question is kept -- ask it now, or add sources first
chat.sourcesTooltip: The selected sources are given to Claude as references with each question.
preview.olderRevisionBanner: This is revision {revision}, the one the citation was made from. The source has a newer one now.
preview.deletedBanner: This source was deleted after it was cited. The passage the citation kept:
sources.emptyBody: Add PDFs, Word documents, text, Markdown or web pages. Questions are answered from the sources you select.
sources.privacy: Sources are stored on this Orbit server. The passages a question retrieves are sent to Claude (Anthropic) to answer it.
sources.deleteBody: This removes the source, its text and its file from this workspace, for every session of it. Citations that quoted it keep their quote, marked as from a deleted source.
